ActorTalk: Derek... my friend. Every time I see a whale, I think of it.
I remember soaring across the sea on its back... its songs... and how, until the very end, it chose life and protection.
Thank you, Commandant. I've come this far thanks to the guidance and support of so many. So no matter what challenges lie ahead, I'll keep moving forward.
You made the same choice it did. Derek would be proud of you.
